name: shimmer
need: Show that work is going on, on the words of a status line, with nothing beside them

--ds-shimmer-glint.default: a `light-dark()` of `--ds-surface` and `--ds-on-primary-container` (requested as a colour role: white in light and dark, the text in the contrast theme)
--ds-shimmer-glint.description: `.ds-shimmer`: the colour of the wave, the copy of the text on top

--ds-shimmer-peak.default: `color-mix(in srgb, var(--ds-text) 55%, transparent)` (requested as a colour role)
--ds-shimmer-peak.description: `.ds-shimmer`: the mask at the crest of the band; only its alpha counts (the glint's strength)

--ds-shimmer-length.description: `.ds-shimmer`: one tile of the wave, the band and the pause after it; it travels one length per `--ds-loop-shimmer`
